raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. young of any bird, anak, anak + equivalent for parent bird: two ~s nestling in the nest, dua ekor anak murai [anak merpati, anak kenari, as approp ] dlm sarangnya; a sparrow feeding its ~s, burung pipit sedang memberi anaknya makan; three lost ~s looking for their mother, tiga ekor anak ayam yg sesat sedang mencari ibunya; 2. ( sl ) young woman, si genit, si manis. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
